messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — need to lock the observability roadmap slices this week. Focus: dashboards (product/ops/finance views), tracing hooks strategy, route-level cost breakdown, and error analytics acceptance criteria. Who's got objections?
Samir: Are we still treating RetailCo and VaultHealth as launch customers for this? they had pretty specific asks last quarter.
Elaine: Yes — RetailCo wants cost-by-route (token-level) exposed in UI + per-model error spike alerts. VaultHealth needs tracing hooks for privacy-safe request correlation. ScaleApps wants latency percentiles by route and automated regressions.
Anita: Proposal for launch criteria (MVP):
- Dashboards: top-5 product routes, 95th latency, success/error rate, tokens/route.
- Cost: per-route cost estimate (USD per 1M tokens) with breakdown by model variant.
- Tracing: default sampling 0.5% + on-demand ramp to 10% for incident windows; PII redaction hooks in pipeline.
- Error analytics: automatic grouping + root-cause tags (model, route, client) and helm for user-facing vs internal errors.
Rio: Concern: instrumentation heat. If we enable 10% ramping across many routes we risk ingest and storage costs. Need a throttled ramp and per-customer caps.
Samir: Suggest compromise: MVP tracing only for top-3 routes per customer, global ramp control in Console, and a queue-based sampler that respects budget.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry-pipeline: 3 PRs pending (partitioning, redact-hook, sampler). Staging tests failing on partitioning edge case.
Anita: For acceptance tests, let's make them executable and small. Example checks:
```
# smoke: dashboard panels exist for route /generate and /embed
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood/test-dashboard?route=/generate | jq '.panels | length > 0'
# tracing: sample rate toggle returns value > 0 and < 100
curl -X GET https://api.redwood/trace-config | jq '.sampling.percent'
```
Samir: Love the executable tests. Also add a financial gate: difference between estimated and real cost at 7 days must be < 30% for sample workload, otherwise hold.
Elaine: Good call. We should also define UX constraints: dashboards must be understandable by product managers (no raw token jargon). Fold 'token cost' into a single friendly metric and an advanced toggle for engineers.
Rio: Ops asks: add tracing hooks for cold-start cause analysis (cache misses, model load time). Those need separate indices to avoid blowing up errors grouping.
Anita: Action items:
- @Samir: draft the per-route cost calc formula (due Thu)
- @Rio: add throttled ramp design + storage caps (due Fri)
- @Elaine: write launch checklist including the 7-day financial gate and usability review (due EOW)
- @Infra-bot: mark staging PRs and re-run partitioning test after Samir/Rio changes :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir: One more tradeoff: do we expose per-customer sampling controls in Console or keep it admin-only for Private customers? That affects scope.
Elaine: Keep it admin-only for launch (reduces UI surface). We can open to customers in a 'controls' beta after metric-stable period.
Anita: I'll draft the acceptance rubric with pass/fail criteria, and include a minimal eval harness to check for quality regressions tied to dashboards.
Elaine: OK — let's reconvene after owners post the draft docs. If drafts look good we'll slot slices into next sprint. :thumbsup:
